name: Microsoft Copilot for legal
desc: Legal skills and plugins for drafting, reviewing and tracking obligations.
desc_zh: 用于起草、审阅和义务跟踪的法律技能与插件。
solves: Redlining by hand loses the firm’s playbook. These skills compare an agreement against it and land the edit as a real tracked change in Word.
solves_zh: 手工改合同会丢掉律所自己的 playbook。这些技能把协议和 playbook 对照，并把修改落成 Word 里真正的修订记录。
best_for: An agreement needs reviewing against house standards, or obligations need tracking.
best_for_zh: 要按内部标准审一份协议，或者要持续跟踪合同义务。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — Microsoft Copilot Blog feed, https://techcommunity.microsoft.com/blog/micros）。 DATE CONFLICT: the page itself carries Oct 15, 2026, while the microsoft.com Copilot blog feed lists the same URL with pubDate 2026-10-23. The page date is used. Successor to what Microsoft previously called Legal Agent. 首次公开日期来源：https://techcommunity.microsoft.com/blog/microsoft-copilot-blog/introducing-microsoft-copilot-for-legal/4564246
